main.description: A creator post on the creator's own PDS. A post with no `visibility` (or `visibility: public`) is a normal public record on the open AT network, and — when authored through a foryour.fans-compatible app — is paired with an `app.bsky.feed.post` (see `bskyUri`). A post with `visibility` `subscribers` or `tier` is GATED: its body is carried in `encryptedBody` (never `text`), any media is encrypted, and it is NEVER also written as an app.bsky.feed.post. See docs/creator-owned-pds.md.

text.description: Cleartext body for a PUBLIC post. MUST be an empty string for a gated post (the real body is in `encryptedBody`). May also be empty for a public post that is only media.

visibility.description: Absent is treated as `public` for backward compatibility with pre-rearchitecture records.

embed.description: Inline public post media, Bluesky-compatible. Public posts only.

media.description: References to fans.foryour.media records on the same PDS. Used for gated media and for media shared with the paired app.bsky.feed.post.

accessPolicy.description: Reference to the fans.foryour.accessPolicy record governing this post. Required for gated posts; omitted for public posts.

encryptedBody.description: The AES-256-GCM-encrypted post body, present ONLY for gated posts. Contains no key material.

labels.description: Self-label content warnings for this post, using the core protocol's self-label mechanism.

langs.description: BCP-47 language codes, mirrored from the paired app.bsky.feed.post so the custom record round-trips everything the Bluesky copy carries. See prompts/bluesky-public-posts.md.

tags.description: Additional hashtags (without a leading '#'), mirrored from the paired app.bsky.feed.post.

bskyUri.description: AT URI of the paired app.bsky.feed.post, for public posts dual-published through a compatible app. Field semantics owned by prompts/bluesky-public-posts.md / docs/bluesky-public-posts.md. Absent on gated posts (never dual-published) and on public posts authored where Bluesky publishing was unavailable.

bskyCid.description: CID of the paired app.bsky.feed.post at publish time.

canonicalUri.description: Which of the paired records is canonical for display/dedupe. This app always sets it to this fans.foryour.post record's own URI. See docs/bluesky-public-posts.md §4.

sourceApp.description: Identifier of the fan-service app that authored this record, e.g. `foryour.fans`.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this post was originally created.

updatedAt.description: Client-declared timestamp of the most recent edit, when edited.

uri.description: AT URI of a fans.foryour.media record.

encryptedBody.description: Contains NO key material — only a reference the key-grant endpoint maps to a per-post content key.

keyRef.description: Opaque per-post content-key identifier. Conventionally this post record's own AT URI.

ciphertext.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM ciphertext of the UTF-8 post body (auth tag appended).
